title: What Color Is the Lens Right Now?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“Hmm~ Right, left, back aisle~
Where is Machan's merchandise~?”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“Well, well. I don't see any.
Or perhaps new goods are in a different spot?”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking there might be some kind of merchandise out by now,
I came with Aston Machan to browse horsegirl goods, but...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “Hrmm, looks like there aren't any yet.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I was on that TV special and made my debut.
I'm sure they'll be lining these shelves in no time flat.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “Yes, looking forward to it. Full of excitement.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Frankly, getting merch made in general shouldn't be too difficult.
However, earning a spot on these mainstream store shelves is another matter...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“It's okay, it's okay. I'll just get much stronger and make a big splash.
Once I do, tons of people will have their eyes on Machan.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“And once they see me, wham! Machan's loveliness
will grab the hearts of everyone in the stands and at home tight.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words and demeanor felt light, airy, and gentle,
yet her determination was fiercely pure and steadfast.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “What's truly sad is being forgotten.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Never let her be forgotten. Keep her remembered forever.
I want to grant that wish of hers no matter what it takes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“Trainer? It's about time to head back.
Whatever are you looking at—”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Waving goodbye to a bewildered Aston Machan,
I briskly walked toward 'it' catching my eye.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“Hmm~? A Trainer in a fluster, how unusual~.
...Hmph.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Why not try making a handmade sachet together?"
A craft shop poster bearing those words had caught my attention.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Using colors and designs inspired by Aston Machan in my own way,
I crafted a small sachet. There's nothing inside it yet, though.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I was on that TV special and made my debut.
I'm sure they'll be lining these shelves in no time flat.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From an outsider's perspective, someone might scoff that it's 'just merch' or 'overdramatic.'
Yet the core of that wish runs profoundly deep—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I became her Trainer to make Aston Machan's dream come true.
If it helps achieve that, I will cling to even the faintest shred of hope.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So this is something like a good-luck charm. Far too crude to be called official merch,
just a single, tiny handmade sachet, but even so—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “...Is that Machan's dream?”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“...I peeked to see where you were heading.
And then you slipped right into a craft shop.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“You picked out fabric, picked out thread, and sat quietly in the workshop corner.
Asking the staff all sorts of questions... looking just a little bit nervous, too.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“Yes. You had such a serious look on your face, stitching stitch after stitch, over and over.
Before I knew it, Machan was watching you the entire time.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“Why, I wonder? I don't really know.
But I just stood there, listening as if to the sound of ocean waves.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“...That sachet has Machan's colors.
It looks like Machan.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “It's almost as if you went and created a brand-new Machan, Trainer.”
choice_data_list: Well, this is... kind of a good-luck charm, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained that it wasn't anything fancy enough to be called Aston Machan merch,
just a self-indulgent good-luck charm.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A good-luck charm? ...So you won't forget Machan?
If you didn't have that, would you forget all about Machan?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: That simply won't do~. Whatever shall we do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan stares intently at me,
with an aura that makes it impossible to tell if she's joking or serious.
choice_data_list: There's no way I'd ever forget.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Not just every day, but multiple times a day—
I'm always thinking about training, and about Aston Machan's dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under those circumstances, forgetting would be impossible.
Recalling the memories we build day by day, thinking about the future—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Even though you remember, you recall them again and again...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Remembering. Thinking. Recalling.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
They are different, aren't they? Being remembered, and being recalled.
They sound similar, but they are completely different.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you remember me,
and yet you recall me over and over again, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Something that doesn't stop. Continuity, repetition. Over and over, like waves.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm-mm??

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It feels... all fizzy inside.
Fizzy and ticklish. And yet, it doesn't feel bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: How strange. What could it be? Fizzy... Hmm-mm?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Aston Machan tilt her head,
I find myself tilting mine right along with her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stepping closer out of nowhere, Aston Machan gazes at the empty
sachet held in my hand. Then, with a gentle poke of her finger—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Please give that sachet to Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Machan wants that.
May I have it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wondering if this crude thing is really okay, I hold up the sachet to inspect it again.
...It really is a bit misshapen. When I ask if she'd rather I remake it—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This one is fine. The very first one you made is what makes it special.
...Ah, but it really does make me feel fizzy.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Looking at it just makes it fizzier and fizzier.
Why could that be~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I hand the sachet over to Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a curious look, yet seemingly playful in her own way,
Aston Machan tilts her head as she stares down at the sachet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After doing that a few times, she turns around
and stares straight into my eyes. And then—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Your lenses always change to the color of the sky, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Leaving me with those words, she turned and walked away.
